x: Gentle persuasion followed and Jack re-emerged exclaiming profusely that his results board would collapse under the strain of 38 walkers. Despite this, all was concluded satisfactorily with a win for Carl Lawton from Peter Hodkinson of Cambridge Harriers.

That makes 25 consecutive appearances and almost as a tribute, although not as John would have liked, he won for the first time the Belgrave long distance trophy. 1.P.Hodkinson(Cambridge H) 8.28.17, ....Bels... 19.J.Keown 10.25.25.
